newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open little changed.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open little changed.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were seen opening little changed Thursday, in line with LME copper, which was steady-to-firmer, despite a further rise in LME warehouse stocks.
COMEX September copper was called to open unchanged to up 0.30 cent a pound from Thursday's close at 106.45 cents.
LME copper stocks rose 7,800 tonnes to 181,150 tonnes Friday. LME stocks have risen 42,025 tonnes this week and since the start of the year are up by about 56 percent.
COMEX copper stocks fell 998 short tonnes to 30,756 short tons Thursday.
But the downtrend of the past three weeks in copper prices still looks to be intact, traders said, with demand easing during the traditionally slow summer period, while stocks are rising.
The LME cash-to-three month spread fell back further early Thursday to around $123.00 a tonne.
COMEX copper prices have tumbled from 12 month highs around 120 cents a pound to a low of 101.50 cents last week, as funds liquidated long positions build during the winter and spring.
